name: DEL Movement Sentence Choir
description: The first ever DEL Movement Sentence Choir in Berlin, facilitated by Dr. Dagmar Spain. This is a unique experimental performance format that uses movement as collective language, bringing together participants in a choreographed communal expression. The event represents an intersection of dance, community practice, and conceptual art, creating space for bodies to speak together in a non-verbal choir of movement. The townhall setting adds a civic dimension to this participatory performance work.
